svg.title: GridGuard AWS sandbox deployment topology
svg.desc: Terraform-defined AWS deployment across two availability zones. Public-ingress, cloud-core, and isolated OT subnets are separated. Fargate runs Grafana, InfluxDB, the Modbus ingestor, and the power simulator. The ingestor alone may poll the OT simulator. Private endpoints provide ECR, S3, CloudWatch Logs, and Secrets Manager access. Runtime resources are disabled and task counts are zero by default; nothing has been applied.
svg.text: Private runtime placement with an isolated OT simulation zone
Default posture: foundation only, no running tasks, no endpoints, no NAT gateway, no public Grafana, no OIDC role.
isolated route table · no default route
no public IP · read-only root FS
NO IGW · NO NAT · ENDPOINTS ONLY

text.tspan: foundation -> images -> secrets -> endpoints/runtime with ×0 -> stateful services -> simulator + ingestor
